description: This Java source file contains the implementation of the BatchApiService, specifically the class BatchApiServiceImpl, which handles batch processing requests within the Apache Fineract project. It manages execution flow for batch requests, including transaction handling, request processing, error handling, and recursive execution of request hierarchies.

classes.name: BatchApiServiceImpl
classes.description: The main class implementing batch processing logic, managing request execution, transaction handling, and recursive request handling within the Apache Fineract batch service architecture.

methods.name: handleBatchRequestsWithoutEnclosingTransaction
methods.description: Processes batch requests without wrapping them in a single enclosing transaction.

methods.name: handleBatchRequestsWithEnclosingTransaction
methods.description: Processes batch requests within a single enclosing transaction.

methods.name: handleBatchRequests
methods.description: Core method that orchestrates batch request handling, delegating to transactional or non-transactional processing.

methods.name: callInTransaction
methods.description: Executes batch requests inside a configured transaction, with retry logic for transient failures.

methods.name: handleRequestNodes
methods.description: Builds execution trees of batch requests and manages their recursive execution.

methods.name: callRequestRecursive
methods.description: Recursively processes a batch request node and its children, handling success or failure cases.

methods.name: executeRequest
methods.description: Executes an individual batch request, invoking the appropriate command strategy and handling errors.

methods.name: runPreprocessors
methods.description: Runs registered preprocessors on a batch request before execution.

methods.name: runPreprocessor
methods.description: Recursively executes a list of preprocessors on a batch request.

methods.name: parentRequestFailedRecursive
methods.description: Generates error responses for child requests when parent requests fail.

methods.description: Builds an error response or throws an exception if transaction rollback criteria are met.
